corrections.critique: Strongest feature: Craig confronts mediated causation by combining regress termination with creation absent preexisting material, making extraordinary power relevant while cautiously characterizing his conclusion as plausible. Principal limitation: Terminating an infinite sequence establishes a first causal member, but not that this terminus produced the universe, furnished intermediary capacities, or possessed enormous power rather than initiating stronger demiurges. Live burden: He needs a non-question-begging bridge from causal priority to comprehensive creative responsibility, explaining why a weak initiator could not originate intermediaries whose capacities accomplish material-free cosmic production. Locked score: The 77 rewards a highly responsive, burden-focused reply while preserving substantial deductions because finite regress termination insufficiently establishes either absolute creatorship or the enormous power attributed to the terminus.
